summary: Black Holes in Outer Wilds are regions of spacetime with gravity strong enough that nothing can escape. Brittle Hollow has a natural black hole at its core; most others in the solar system were artificially created by the Nomai at the Black Hole Forge for use in warp travel.

biology: A black hole is a region of spacetime exhibiting gravity so strong that nothing — not even energy — can escape it.
location: Brittle Hollow contains a natural black hole at its core.
The Black Hole Forge is located near the natural black hole at the center of Brittle Hollow.
lore: Most of the black holes in Outer Wilds were created by the Nomai, not formed naturally.
The Nomai created black holes at the Black Hole Forge in order to craft warp cores.
In real-world physics, black holes most commonly form through the gravitational collapse of a massive star.
mechanics: Black holes accept all matter that enters them; white holes reject all matter and prevent entry.
Warp travel in Outer Wilds uses a paired black hole and white hole.
